notes.title: WarpedSpace - Patch Notes Build 690
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/e41aa0f1921343b5d549f8d7d4953ddb0137c81f.png"]

🚀 Warped Space - Build: 690 - Patch Notes: 

Date Range: May 27 – June 20, 2025

Hey explorers! We've been hard at work improving core systems, expanding survival mechanics, and fixing long-standing issues. This update brings the first pass of the Base Building Tool update, as building is now via the Build Tool. Also improvements such as quality-of-life upgrades, hydration survival mechanics, new hostile lifeforms, and more.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Build System & Base Updates
⚒️ Build Tool Snap System (Prototype) Added – Early stages of snapping for build tool for more intuitive base construction.

🧱 Fixed base component power distribution – newly placed components now receive power from the base manager

🧰 Base Fabricator Fixes:

Now buildable again.

No longer duplicates items.

UI updated.

🧹 Storage cleanup improvements: deleted items are now removed and storage transfer is smoother (1-at-a-time logic).

🌱 New Modules & Systems:

Planter added to Research HAB.

Hydro Incubator and Base Refinery are now buildable.

Planting cycle introduced; supports multiple item types.

⚒️ The Forge has been slightly improved and it awaiting playtest feedback 

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/0b22853d48c8da2f9911b044e1cec7163b9ec7a1.png"]
[hr][/hr]🧪 Research & Missions
🧬 Auto Research bugs squashed.

🧾 Default Schematics now behave like normal schematics.

📜 Mission system improvements:

Missions can now reward research unlocks.

Added one new mission, removed one outdated.

Updated and fixed multiple test mission locations.

Fixed beacon markers and hostile DPS readouts.


Worm Added to remote asteroid caves 😉

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/e4f6d32ecfe52356807e6eddb165e60b8dd2acb6.png"]


New Locations to explore in the works:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/66ff8f5bf2c75118acd91d283bf772cb66a7d381.png"]


[hr][/hr]🧍‍♂️ Survival Mechanics: Hydration!
💧 Hydration system implemented:

Affects movement (walk/run/EVA).

Monitor hydration status through new UI badge.

🧴 Craftable Water Bottles:

Right-click to drink.

🧪 Water Purifier module added for testing.

🔈 Added eating and drinking SFX.

🔧 Various fixes to consumption logic and hydration effects.



Water Purifier Added

Craft water bottles and fill them with water purified from ice fragment.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/bcf01d03a3ccbc87b35413c337ece3183170deac.png"]


[hr][/hr]🧑‍🚀 EVA, Tools & Utility Improvements
🔦 Torch brightness can now be adjusted while holstered.

🛸 Ship spotlight brightness can also be adjusted in the same way.

👨‍🚀 Exit to EVA check, now functions correctly while docked in space dock.

🔋 Updated Space Dock regen chamber position.

🛠️ Updated Tools + Beam Salvaging logic, for a consistent, controlled yield and future gameplay.

Scannable items now show was unknown until scanned


[hr][/hr]🧪 Cinematics & UX
🎬 Introduced Work-in-Progress Opening Cinematic:

1st phase now implemented.

Now skippable and only plays when starting a new game.

🛑 Removed placeholder comic cinematic & Added loading text to loading screen.



  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/31233260a2c7f7ba0235d511b206b945f4590662.png"]
[hr][/hr]👾 Notable Bug Fixes & optimizations 
👹 New hostile creature variant added.

🧬 Updated creature blink behavior.

🧠 Optimized databank entry logic.

🎨 UI & Icon improvements.

🧠 Keybind error checking added.

⚙️ Numerous bugfixes across gameplay systems.

🛠️ Fixed: Salvage tool not salvaging !

⚙️Improved Interactions with: Doors, Gravity, Lights etc.

⚙️Major Bug Fixed - with streaming in location from disc, with the knock on effect of fixing

 audio logs to play 3 times

3 x the hostiles spawned and loot

and other effects....


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/109bf3cc87bf0df6ce463537192ee3cf8c8ff828.png"]
[hr][/hr]

Thanks again for playing Warped Space the Feedback is Important. 
More content, polish, and surprises are on the way. Stay tuned and keep exploring!


See you in the void,
 – WarpedSpaceDev

notes.title: WarpedSpace - Patch Notes Build 642d
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/03d4a7f075cb968eab78df8f3cf1088b637228ed.png

🚀 Greetings Explorers!
This update is packed with:  mission system improvements, bug fixes, UI updates, and expansions to core gameplay systems like building, scanning, EVA and now access to the new Forge System! [Testing Phase] 
 Thanks for all your continued support and feedback!

🌌 Story & Mission System
Story System Updated now supports multi-system missions and improvements to the current mission/story system.
Skimmer Missions – Introduced with supporting content.
Improved Mission System UX – Tasks and markers better reflect mission states.
Hostile Skimmer – Introduced with mission integration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/2f0ddf74312dd44852495a5e3b990df4be7b769c.png

🏗️ Base Building & Construction
Base Building Mechanics Improved:
- Materials are now consumed during construction.
- Deconstruction implemented.
- Storage Items must be empty to be removed.
- Habitats can only be removed if anything built inside them has been removed.
- Added banners for Construction/Deconstruction status and material usage.
- Added Build Error Sound for better feedback.

Buildable Base Modules Added
Planter, Base Fabricator, Regen Pod, Small Habitat, Storage Shelf, Storage Locker
Base Shields & Shield Modules
- Feature Proximity-based On/Off.

General Improvements
Gravity and Air simulation improved.
Updated help panel and dynamic tooltips for Build Tool and other modes.
Help Panels – Now dynamically reflect context and added Regen Pod help.
Action Prompts Improved
- Now linked to Range Finder marker.
- Updated to support each tool context.
- Fixed flickering when tractoring.
- Wall of Debris – Now pushable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/50a31a47d5d582f89536e264ebac90eb0724c8c3.png

🧪 Research System
UI Updates
Cleaner interface.
Research Now Reveals schematic requirements
Removed % once research is complete.
Added filters for better navigation.


🧠 Ship & EVA Updates
EVA Boost Improved
- Smoother ramp-up and better speed gain.
- Slower oxygen drain.
- New VFX and Camera Shake (toggle option coming soon™).

Agility Module Improvements
- More accurately affect strafe speeds.
Fixed bug where movement suddenly became too sensitive.
Ion Field Effect – Updated to impact ship speed correctly.
Shield Bug Fix – Ship is no longer indestructible if shield was 0 HP but active.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/1cd2560b194ac4db82cdabea13568134f9496c38.png

🌠 Null Space & Warp Gates
Null Space Warp Gates Re-Implemented
- Now uses new gate tech.
- Return gate updated.
- Improved transitions and visuals.
- Large Warper NPC Squid - can now drop warp tunnels again.

System Updates
Meteoroids now remain in their system when jumping
Skyboxes now update properly when returning from Null Space.

📡 Scanning & Exploration
Scanning Update 
 - Supports both Passive and Active Scanning.
 - Item Scan Progress now persists


 🛠️ Added Forge System 🛠️ 
Now testable via [F5]
The ability to Merge Ship Expansion Modules 
Improve the ships performance in almost every way
Agility, Rate of Fire, Armor Regen, Weapon Energy Pool 
and much more!

🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed long-standing shield/armor bug making ships invulnerable.
Ship computer now marks collectibles without needing to re-board.

Thanks again for playing Warped Space the Feedback is Important. 
More content, polish, and surprises are on the way. Stay tuned and keep exploring!

- Warped Space Dev

notes.title: WarpedSpace - Patch Notes Build 588d
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/9432c1616ed3af7c4777653f0c60cd4e8068ae02.png

WarpedSpace - Patch Notes Build 588d

🛠️ Warped Space - Patch Notes (Mar 26 – Apr 13, 2025)

✨ Some Highlights
New Hostile Space Squid Variant added.
Shield Modules are now lootable again!

Transfer Dock added to the Starter Base.
- currently only transfers Ice fragments to the Oxygen Tank.

New Base Building Template (Part 1) with partial load-in and construction updates.
Added De-Construct VFX to Build Tool (Temp) for a more visual experience.
Re-added the ability to remove built items.

Added DeConstructor to Ship Panel – break down unwanted items.
Ice Fragments now spawn near the starter base (testing phase).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/123e9e5e2f186383cc0ffe9905af03e2fc1da5d9.png

⚙️ Gameplay & Balance
Ships can no longer shoot through hollow asteroids.

Most Hostiles now guards areas and won’t chase players forever.
- Targeting range reduced for said hostiles.

Game now checks inventory/equipped items to auto-complete already completed first tasks.

Base Oxygen will now only reduce while the player is inside the base.
- Base oxygen levels can no longer go negative.

🧠 NPC's & Missions
Mission system now prevents preloading areas that are too far away.
Fighter spawn parameters updated for better balance.

Fixed a bug where "First Tasks" got stuck on: Research Scanning Tool.

🛠️ UI / UX Improvements
Inventory stacking now displays correctly without needing a refresh.
Inventory now shows accurate item counts.

Base Manager will now only display Base Modules.
New tooltip system applied to ship setup and base modules (Refinery, Fabricator).

Fabricator UI opens/closes more consistently.

Build Tool UI Updated: Includes ESC-to-exit, improved hints, and feedback.
Build Tool can now deconstruct incomplete builds.
Tool Wheel unequip now holsters tool before unequipping.

🔊 Audio Updates
Ship collision audio now reflects impact speed.
Drone probe sounds updated to sound more accurate; adjusted audio range.

🧊 Visual & Effects
Updated Ion Field effect on ship engines.
Updated : Improved interiors, animated doors, and enhanced lighting.

🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed bug where ship became 'slippery' after Eject.
Fixed Starter Base door issue.
Fixed a tractor beam visual glitch when switching targets.
Fixed character module equipping issue on first-time play.
Fixed long-standing bug with persistent item deletion, which also affected looting respawn capsules.
Close button tooltips no longer lingers.

Saving system improved: now handles HDD full and keeps a backup file.

Base Manager and Oxygen Systems stability fixes.

⚡ Performance
Minor optimizations across the board.
Improved performance with data lookups.


Thank you for your continued support 🚀 
Keep the feedback coming!```

Feel free to share your thoughts and discoveries on our discord or social media.

🛰️ See you in the stars! 🛠️

📢 Warped Space Demo - Patch Notes (Build 542b) & Development Update 📢

Big batch of updates and improvements! Here's what's Improved:

🔹 Inventory & Storage Enhancements
Ship Storage & Inventory now have scrolling views – no more overflowing icons!
Scroll views now have limits to prevent over-scrolling.
Ship Setup Scroll View updated with limits.
Inventory system now reuses deleted indexes, making it more efficient.

🔹 Bug Fixes & UI Improvements
Fixed a bug with Base Manager.
Fixed Ion Drive incorrectly displaying "Damaged" when fully repaired.
Research List is now sortable via heading buttons.
Resolved overlapping issues in the Research List.
Added Beacon Panel & Updated Messages Panel.

🔹 Gameplay & Interaction Tweaks
Adjusted interaction range for some items.
Adjusted ship call speed for better responsiveness.
Ship's AI no longer talks over datalog messages.
Beacon Schematic now appears when a beacon is scanned.

🔹 Story & Missions
Re-Implemented Starter Story/Mission System
Added: Tester Story/Mission - Part 1 has been added!
Story/Mission system now loads content and locations from disk.
Expanded the Demo Area (just a little 20 meters).

Cleaned up TAB function for smoother UI navigation.

More to come soon! Thanks for following the development of Warped Space! 🚀✨

notes.title: Warped Space Demo Update - Build 527b
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/7b5d6f7a8175d2ab5de7b9bda387f822d920d843.png

📢 Warped Space Demo - Patch Notes (Build 527b) 📢


🚀 Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Improvements
Fixed a bug where pressing ESC while in Interact Mode would lock the player.
ESC now properly closes more UI elements, including:
Ship Setup, Base Fabricator, Base Refinery

Fixed an issue where removing the rebreather would cause max oxygen to drop to an old default.
Fixed a bug preventing some items from appearing in Schematics.
Fixed CO2 Scrubber crafting issue.
Fixed Ion Drive Repair message.
Fixed inventory-related issues.

🛠 UI & Input Improvements
Added a Ship Storage Close Button for convenience.
Integrated Top Menu Buttons into the Inventory Panel (TABS).
Updated UI Inputs while in the Feedback Dialog (now properly enabled/disabled).

Added more Info Graphics to improve onboarding for new players.
Helper text no longer covers the Modules Button.
Added a Continue Button to the loading screen and cinematic placeholder flow.

⚙️ Gameplay & Mechanics
Ship External Panel: Players can now remove and install Power Cores via the external panel. 
The system will automatically replace the core with the best one found in the inventory.
Respawn Capsule Update: Players can no longer transfer items into the Respawn Capsule—only extraction is allowed.
Item Charge Bar: Now properly displays a max limit of 100%.
Rebalanced Starter Area Sentry Drone Drops.
Gravity Fixes: Gravity has been fixed in both the upper and lower levels of the Starter Base.

🏗️ Environment & World Updates
Updated Default Space Dock and surrounding areas.
Increased the size of Space Docks slightly.
🔑 Keybind Updates (Defaults—won't affect existing installations unless reset)

TAB → Opens Inventory (New Default)
1,2,3,4,5 → Ship Modes (while piloting) / Tools (while FPS/EVA)

🔬 Research & Crafting Updates
Research UI now shows "Requires: Refinery" for refining formulas.
Added CO2 Scrubber Schematic with a blue icon for clarity.
CO2 Scrubber => Now Rebreather.

Thank you to everyone for their constructive feedback! 🚀
